title: Mapping the individual, social, and biospheric impacts of Foundation Models
findings: The paper cites research demonstrating that foundation models exhibit persistent religious bias. For example, prompts containing the word 'Muslim' were found to produce responses with violent language, which can contribute to targeted hate and disinformation campaigns centered around anti-Muslim or Islamophobic sentiments.
